home.title: Open Keychain 3D | Name keychain maker
home.description: Make free 3D printable name keychains, articulated names, nameplates, and plant labels in your browser. Export STL or 3MF locally.
home.heading: Make a 3D printable keychain from any name.
home.intro: Open Keychain 3D turns a name or short label into a printable model without installing CAD software or uploading your design.
home.templatesBody: Start with a name keychain, articulated name, nameplate, or plant label, then adjust the style and export a file for your slicer.
home.workflowBody: Enter text, choose a shape, check the preview, and download STL or 3MF. Geometry and exports stay in your browser.
home.privacyHeading: Your design stays on your device

faq.question: Can I export an STL file?
faq.answer: Yes. The customizer validates the model and lets you download an STL or 3MF file for your slicer.

faq.question: Do I need CAD software?
faq.answer: No. Open Keychain 3D creates the parametric model in your browser, so you can start with a name and a template.

faq.question: Is my name uploaded?
faq.answer: No. In the browser workflow, your text and generated geometry stay on your device.

nameKeychain.title: Open Keychain 3D | Name keychain maker
nameKeychain.description: Create a personalized 3D printable name keychain with a keyring hole. Choose a style, preview the geometry, and export STL or 3MF locally.
nameKeychain.heading: Create a personalized 3D printable name keychain.
nameKeychain.intro: Turn a first name, nickname, or short word into a practical keychain tag. The name keychain template includes a keyring hole and raised lettering designed for a straightforward home print.

faq.question: What makes this a printable name keychain?
faq.answer: The template combines a backing shape, a keyring hole, and raised lettering that you can inspect before exporting.

faq.question: Can I change the style?
faq.answer: Yes. Select from the available contour, arch, bubble, capsule, and soft-tag styles in the customizer.

articulatedName.title: Open Keychain 3D | Articulated name printing
articulatedName.description: Make a flexible articulated name keychain for 3D printing. Preview linked letters and export a validated STL or 3MF file locally.
articulatedName.heading: Make an articulated name keychain for 3D printing.
articulatedName.intro: Create a playful linked name with captive joints between letters. The articulated template is designed for a flexible keyring that can move after printing.

faq.question: What is an articulated name keychain?
faq.answer: It is a connected name design with movable joints between letters, giving the finished print a flexible feel.

faq.question: Does the model check the joints?
faq.answer: The customizer validates articulated clearances and reports when a shorter name or different font is needed.

nameplate.title: Open Keychain 3D | Custom nameplate maker
nameplate.description: Design a compact 3D printable nameplate for a desk, drawer, shelf, or workspace. Preview the text and export STL or 3MF locally.
nameplate.heading: Design a compact 3D printable nameplate.
nameplate.intro: Make a personalized plaque for a desk, drawer, shelf, or maker workspace. The nameplate template keeps the lettering readable and the backing easy to inspect before export.

faq.question: Where can I use the nameplate?
faq.answer: It is suited to desks, drawers, shelves, maker spaces, and other places where a compact printed label is useful.

faq.question: Can I adjust the text height?
faq.answer: Yes. Use the text and shape controls to tune the lettering and backing within printable limits.

plantLabel.title: Open Keychain 3D | Plant label generator
plantLabel.description: Create a personalized 3D printable plant label with a pointed stake. Choose a style, preview the geometry, and export STL or 3MF locally.
plantLabel.heading: Make a personalized 3D printable plant label.
plantLabel.intro: Turn a plant name, herb, or garden note into a durable label with a pointed stake. Preview the text and shape before sending the file to your slicer.
benefits: Pointed stake for pots and beds

faq.question: What is the plant label for?
faq.answer: Use it for pots, herbs, seedlings, small garden rows, or any plant that needs a clear printed marker.

faq.question: Can I choose a different label style?
faq.answer: Yes. Plant labels support the available contour, arch, bubble, capsule, and soft-tag styles.
